# bladerf

> Nuand bladeRF — full-duplex transmit-capable SDR with an on-board FPGA

**Vendor:** Nuand

Status: **supported** — the identifiers and setup recipe are believed correct.

**Not maintainer-verified**: nobody on this project has run this hardware yet. The two facts are recorded separately on purpose (D-027) — a correct recipe and a tested device are different claims.

## What it is

A full-duplex software defined radio with an on-board FPGA, able to transmit and receive at once — which most of the cheaper devices cannot.

## What you can do with it

Anything needing simultaneous transmit and receive, and FPGA work for processing that has to happen before the data reaches the host.

## Setup

Install the packages, add yourself to plugdev, and load a matching FPGA image with bladeRF-cli. The image is not shipped with the library and must be fetched separately.

## Known problems

Three USB identifiers across generations, so a rule written for one board silently does not match another. Host library, firmware and FPGA image are version-coupled.

## How it identifies itself

| USB id | What | Confirmed | Node |
|---|---|---|---|
| `2cf0:5250` | bladeRF 2.0 micro | yes | libusb |
| `2cf0:5246` | bladeRF x40 / x115 | yes | libusb |
| `1d50:6066` | bladeRF, OpenMoko-allocated identifier used by earlier firmware | yes | libusb |

## Access and permissions

Group membership required: `plugdev` — added at install, applies at next login.

The generated udev rule provides a `/dev/bladerf` symlink, mode `0660`, group `plugdev`.

## Firmware modes

- **vendor_tool** — tooling: [`libbladerf2`](../packages/libbladerf2.md)
  bladeRF-cli loads FPGA images and updates firmware. The FPGA bitstream is a separate download from the firmware and both are version-matched to the host library; a mismatch reports as an obscure initialisation failure.

## Software that makes it useful

[`gqrx-sdr`](../packages/gqrx-sdr.md), [`libbladerf2`](../packages/libbladerf2.md), [`soapysdr-module-bladerf`](../packages/soapysdr-module-bladerf.md)

**Upstream:** <https://www.nuand.com/>
